request.prompt: Generate 30 million seeded pseudo-random u64 values. Keep the original vector and a sorted copy in memory at the same time, verify the sorted copy is a permutation of the original by comparing wrapping sums and XORs, and report min, max, median and both checksums in /work/artifacts/result.json. This needs roughly 500 MiB of memory.
